statement.text:
For finite groups G, X define r(G; X) to be the number of inequivalent actions
of G on X, that is, the number of equivalence classes of homomorphisms G → Aut X,
where equivalence is defined by conjugation by an element of Aut X. Now define
rG (n) := max{r(G; X) : |X| = n}.
    Is it true that rG (n) may be bounded as a function of λ(n), the total number
(counting multiplicities) of prime factors of n?                     P. M. Neumann
